verdict.rationale: Unleash documents role-based access control at both root and project levels, with predefined roles and, on Enterprise, custom root and project roles for fine-grained permissions (unleash-docs-12, unleash-docs-42, unleash-docs-32, unleash-gh-3). API tokens are scoped: backend tokens are limited to one or more projects and a single environment (unleash-docs-15, unleash-docs-23, unleash-docs-34). missing for 10: details of the actual permission set and any per-flag or per-environment permission granularity, evidence of scoping for admin/automation tokens beyond SDK backend tokens, custom roles being Enterprise-only, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
